thread:
lena: quick flag check  after the kernel-selector tweak landed we're seeing host p99 regressions on short-seq workloads (chat-small).
omar: confirmed in prod metrics. p50 unchanged, p99 decode+ingress up ~2x. grabbing traces now.
olam: (typo) meant to say grabbing traces -> here's a sampled flamegraph: https://perf.company/fg/2322000000 (5s). tokeniz and net write spikes.
zane: top stack looks like:
```
ingress.parse -> tokenizer.tokenize_prefix -> kernel_selector.choose_fast -> net.writev
```
we moved prefix tokenize earlier, and kernel churn increased.
lena: kvcache global miss rate stable (~3.8%), so not a KV hotpath. But smallwrite ratio jumped from 15% -> 36% on the canary.
kai: hypothesis: earlier tokenization causes smaller outbound frames, reducing writev coalescing. two quick mitigations: (1) micro-coalesce writev window (500us-2ms) behind feature flag, (2) prefix lookup before tokenizing (prefixKVC) to avoid work.
omar: microbench: added a 1ms coalesce in sidecar, ran bench: `./bench --qps 300 --payload small --out results.json` -> p99 decode+ingress went from 26ms -> 13ms on emulator.
zane: here's the patch sketch for micro-coalesce (pseudo):
```
if payload_size < 1024 and pending_writes < 64 {
  wait up to coalesce_window_us
  gather small frames
  writev(all)
}
```
kai: adaptive is key. we shouldn't add latency when qps high. suggest gating on outstanding_requests_per_core and route_priority.
lena: prefixKVC: hash first 64B of request, lookup in route-scoped cache -> if hit return token ids; if miss fallthrough and populate. early logs show ~11% identical-prefix rate for small-chat customers.
omar: prefix lookup adds a memory lookup (~200ns) but saves tokenization (~1.1us per prefix on avg) when hit. good ROI if hit > ~5%.
zane: also noticed HPACK compress cost rising due to many small header frames. might need header dedupe or keepalive tuning.
deploy-bot: rolling canary 2322000000 -> 2322000000-rc1 to 4 hosts at 2026-03-23T10:04:00Z
lena: propose immediate plan:
- gate rollback window if micro-coalesce doesn't improve host p99 in 30m (owner: omar)
- land micro-coalesce behind flag and run canary (owner: kai)
- prototype prefixKVC in a route-limited experiment (owner: zane)
- add per-route smallwrite ratio telemetry & HPACK stats (owner: lena)
- measure syscall count (/proc/<pid>/syscalls) on canary hosts (owner: omar)

oncall-bot: @eng-oncall alerting configured for latency > 40ms p99 on important routes.

kai: opened PR wip: https://git.company/p/runtime/pulls/4621 (coalesce behind `runtime.coalesce_us`)

zane: preparing replay job to estimate prefixKVC hit realism across 24h logs.
lena: thanks team. tagging @eng-sre to watch node CPU and syscalls during canary. will update dashboards with smallwrite ratio breakdown.
omar: keeping live traces running; will post flamegraphs + syscall diffs.
